engines._comment: Matches Dockerfile (node:24-alpine / node:24-slim / NodeSource node_24.x) + .nvmrc (24); ship an LTS line only — node 25 reached end of life on 2026-06-01. Lumastra has never been tested on <22; the old '>=20.3.0' floor pre-dated the Svelte 5 / Vitest 4 upgrades that assume Node 22+ APIs.

node_modules/node-abort-controller.deprecated: This package is no longer needed on supported Node.js versions. Node.js 16+ includes AbortController and AbortSignal as built-in globals. All Node.js versions requiring this polyfill are end-of-life. Use the built-in globals instead.
